name: JupyterLite
tagline: A Python notebook that lives in this file. Invite shares the cells.
description:
The notebook is the file. Close it, come back, every cell and its output is still there. Press Invite and someone else lands in the same notebook — no JupyterHub, no Google account, no server. After Python downloads once (about 10 MB), it works on a plane.

This is a notebook and a CPython kernel, not the full JupyterLab file browser. Cells are code or text. Shift+Enter runs a cell (on a phone, the play button on the cell). The kernel is Python 3.12 with the standard library: math, json, collections, datetime, statistics, pathlib. numpy and matplotlib are not in this file. There is no pip.

A Welcome notebook is already open the first time, so the first Run can print π. Download a .ipynb out, or open one in.

Unofficial port of JupyterLite. Their demo forgets the notebook when you clear the site data. This one does not — the GIF is the save.
